title: Rollup projection schema and per-project producer
description: WHY: the rollup is the only data contract between projects and the global layer, so its schema and freshness discipline carry the whole design. WHAT: (1) define the versioned rollup document (schemas/projections/ home): project id, schema version, generatedAt, work counts by status and kind, limbo lists (verified and needs_verification item ids with ages), active and expired reservation counts, open blocking enforcement gaps summary, doctor and sync ok flags, last event timestamp, and the top next directives (bounded, reusing the bwrk next selection); (2) producer writes .boreal/rollup.json atomically on every state-mutating command - hook it where refreshWorkContext already runs (packages/engine/src/runtime.ts) plus doctor and sync refresh; keep production under a few milliseconds by computing from the already-loaded snapshot, never a second store read; (3) bwrk rollup show --json to inspect the local rollup; (4) doctor validates rollup freshness against state contentHash the same way the search index is validated (apps/cli/src/search-cli.ts pattern).
acceptanceCriteria: Every mutating command leaves rollup.json consistent with state, verified by a test that mutates then diffs rollup counts against a fresh computation
Rollup schema validates and doctor flags a stale rollup
